description.zh: 边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。
description.en: The edge instance ID. You can obtain the ID by hovering the mouse pointer over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

description.zh:
物联网平台的实例ID：
- 企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在[物联网平台控制台](http://iot.console.aliyun.com/)的**实例概览**页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
- 公共实例：无需传入此参数。
description.en:
The instance ID of the IoT Platform:
- Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view your Enterprise instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the [IoT Platform console](http://iot.console.aliyun.com/).
- Public instance: This parameter is not required.

description.zh: 消息路由名称。长度限制为4~32个字符，汉字和全角符号算2个字符。
description.en: The name of the message routing. It must be 4 to 32 characters in length. Each Chinese character or full-width symbol counts as two characters.

description.zh:
消息来源的数据，取值分如下几种情况：

- **SourceType**取值为**device**时： 
    - 如果由指定产品下的指定设备发送消息，则此处取值格式为`/{Your_ProductKey}/{Your_DeviceName}`。

        > 请将{Your_ProductKey}和{Your_DeviceName}替换为您实际设备的ProductKey和DeviceName。

    - 如果由指定产品下的所有设备发送消息，则此处取值格式为`/{Your_ProductKey}/+`。

        > 请将{Your_ProductKey}替换为您实际设备的ProductKey。

    - 如果由边缘实例中所有产品下的所有设备发送消息，则此处取值为`#`。

- **SourceType**取值为**function**：此处取值为边缘应用的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**应用管理**页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID。

-  **SourceType**取值为**IotHub**时：无需传入此参数。
description.en:
The data from the message source. The value format depends on the **SourceType** parameter:

- When **SourceType** is **device**:
    - If the message is sent by a specific device under a specific product, the value must be in the format `/{Your_ProductKey}/{Your_DeviceName}`.

        > Replace {Your_ProductKey} and {Your_DeviceName} with the actual ProductKey and DeviceName of your device.

    - If the message is sent by all devices under a specific product, the value must be in the format `/{Your_ProductKey}/+`.

        > Replace {Your_ProductKey} with the actual ProductKey of your device.

    - If the message is sent by all devices under all products in the edge instance, the value is `#`.

- When **SourceType** is **function**: The value is the ID of the edge application. You can obtain this ID by hovering the mouse pointer over the target application name on the **Application Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

- When **SourceType** is **IotHub**: This parameter is not required.

description.zh:
消息来源，取值如下：
- **device**：表示消息由设备发出。
- **function**：表示消息由边缘应用发出。
- **IotHub**：表示消息由云端发出。
description.en:
The message source. Valid values:
- **device**: indicates that the message is sent by a device.
- **function**: indicates that the message is sent by an edge application.
- **IotHub**: indicates that the message is sent by the cloud.

description.zh:
消息接收者的数据，取值分如下几种情况：
- **TargetType**取值为**function**时：此处取值为边缘应用的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**应用管理**页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID。
- **TargetType**取值为**IotHub**时：无需传入此参数。
description.en:
The data of the message recipient. The value depends on the following cases:
- When **TargetType** is set to **function**, the value is the ID of the edge application. You can obtain the ID by hovering the mouse pointer over the target application name on the **Application Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).
- When **TargetType** is set to **IotHub**, this parameter is not required.

description.zh:
服务级别。取值如下：

- **0**：表示消息仅发送一次，不管是否被消息接收者成功接收。

- **1**：表示最少发送一次消息，直至收到消息接收者的返回信息，则停止发送该消息。

> 当**TargetType**为**IoTHub**时，必须传入此参数。
description.en:
Quality of Service (QoS) level. Valid values:

- **0**: The message is sent only once, regardless of whether it is successfully received by the recipient.

- **1**: The message is sent at least once, and transmission stops only after an acknowledgment is received from the recipient.

> This parameter is required when **TargetType** is **IoTHub**.

description.zh:
消息接收者，取值分如下几种情况：
- **SourceType**取值为**device**时：该参数可取的值为**function**或**IotHub**，表示由设备发出的消息，传给边缘应用或云端。
- **SourceType**取值为**function**时：该参数可取的值为**function**或**IotHub**，表示由边缘应用发出的消息，传给另一个边缘应用或云端。
- **SourceType**取值为**IotHub**时：该参数可取的值为**function**，表示由云端发出的消息，传给边缘应用。
description.en:
The message recipient. The valid values depend on the **SourceType** parameter:
- When **SourceType** is **device**, this parameter can be set to **function** or **IotHub**, indicating that the message from a device is delivered to an edge application or the cloud.
- When **SourceType** is **function**, this parameter can be set to **function** or **IotHub**, indicating that the message from an edge application is delivered to another edge application or the cloud.
- When **SourceType** is **IotHub**, this parameter can only be set to **function**, indicating that the message from the cloud is delivered to an edge application.

description.zh:
消息过滤条件，取值如下：
- 具体消息Topic：表示来自消息源，且符合该消息Topic的消息，会被传给消息接收者。Topic相关信息，请参见[什么是Topic](~~73731~~)。
- **all**：表示来自消息源的所有消息，都会被传给消息接收者。
description.en:
The filter condition for messages. Valid values:
- A specific message topic: Messages from the source that match this topic are forwarded to the recipient. For more information about topics, see [What is a topic?](~~73731~~).
- **all**: All messages from the source are forwarded to the recipient.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
- 如果在企业版实例中调用该接口，必须传入参数**IotInstanceId**的值。否则，调用接口会失败。
- 单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
- If you call this API in an Enterprise instance, you must specify the **IotInstanceId** parameter. Otherwise, the API call fails.
- The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account is 10.
    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-edge-instance-message-routing --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id nF9oXo7kLRWQ00000000 --name le_lite2 --topic-filter all --source-type device --source-data '#' --target-type function --target-data 58c46749ac934db3925fe500000000 --target-iot-hub-qos 0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CreateEdgeInstanceMessageRouting --region cn-hangzhou --TargetData 58c46749ac934db3925fe500000000 --TopicFilter all --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --InstanceId nF9oXo7kLRWQ00000000 --SourceType device --TargetType function --TargetIotHubQos 0 --SourceData '#' --Name le_lite2
